scenario_description: A locked generated calibration bundle keeps its host result inside the networkless sandbox.
expected: Copied component bytes match both locked SHA-256 values inside the container.
Every input and output contract passes and the final artifact equals the reviewed host calibration result.
Non-root, filesystem, cgroup, egress, and sensitive-name preflight checks all pass.
Adapter evidence stays immutable, post-execution component hashes match, and cleanup is confirmed.
observed: Both copied artifacts matched before and after execution and every contract passed with the exact host-calibration final report.
All thirteen non-root, filesystem, cgroup, egress, and secret-name preflight checks passed.
Both components used UID/GID 65534 and verbose in-container timeouts; adapter evidence stayed immutable and exact cleanup removed the container.
notes: PASS applies to this hardened calibration bundle; production runtime mode remains disabled.
